note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000; these are gameplay classifications. Economy: transition economy with partial privatisation, heavily agricultural. Elections: competitive multi-party elections (1998 parliamentary, 1996 presidential). Press: a mix of state and private media. Conscription: universal male service. Religion: secular constitution. Healthcare: state system inherited from the USSR (compulsory health insurance came later). Energy: dependent on imported gas and electricity.
